description: He wears an opaque navy knee-length tunic with gold geometric tablet-woven trim around the neckline, center opening, cuffs and hem. A pale cream shirt shows at the neckline and wrists. A dark brown long mantle with gold borders falls from the shoulders, fastened by two large round metal brooches and a short connecting chain. A brown belt with ornate round gold fittings and a long decorated tail marks the waist. Dark trousers and tall brown leather boots secured with crossing straps are fully visible. Fabric appears heavy and woven; exact fiber is uncertain.
